title: NEO AI Evaluations - evidence packs and public verifier (Official Test No. 3)
description:
Evidence packs of the official tests of LILI, the AI system of NEO AI, and the public verifier that recomputes their published figures.

Official Test No. 3 (22 November 2026): 99 tasks with one known answer, five systems, 495 answers. The protocol and its two thresholds were published and time-stamped before the run; the results are sealed in a hash-chained ledger and time-stamped by third parties; the per-task results are public, and ten tasks drawn by a public source of randomness are published in full.

Verifiable by anyone: node verify/cli.mjs verify packs/test-3. The pack attests the integrity and the dates of the published files and lets a reader recompute every published figure; it does not prove how the run was conducted. No external party has supervised, reproduced or audited the tests.
notes: Software (verify/, the workflow) is under the MIT licence; the data of the evidence packs are under CC BY 4.0. Publisher: NEO TECH LABS TECHNOLOGY L.L.C.
